Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering
.
Business:
Digital Platforms
Principal Responsibilities
Applied AI for Engineering Productivity (Design/Coding/Testing)
Identify high-impact opportunities to use AI to improve mobile engineering outcomes across design, coding, testing, release readiness, and incident response.
Build and operationalise AI-assisted workflows for engineers (e.g., code generation and refactoring support, test case generation, defect triage, documentation automation, release note drafting), ensuring strong governance and quality controls.
Develop AI-powered accelerators and reusable components (e.g., prompt patterns, evaluators, automation scripts, agentic workflows) that teams can adopt with minimal friction.
Establish practical guidance for “how we use AI here” for common engineering tasks—balancing speed with correctness, security, and maintainability.
Data Engineering & Mobile Data Products
Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and curated datasets using mobile-related data sources such as: app telemetry, crash logs, performance metrics, network traces, CI/CD signals, test execution, feature usage analytics, customer journeys, and support/incident data.
Define data models that enable consistent, trusted reporting and AI use cases (e.g., quality and stability KPIs, release health, funnel analysis, defect leakage, performance regression tracking).
Implement data quality checks, lineage, monitoring, and documentation so stakeholders can trust and reuse the data confidently.
Collaborate with security and risk partners to ensure compliant data handling, access controls, and responsible use of customer and operational data.
Dashboards & Decision Intelligence (Data-Driven Mobile)
Build dashboards and decision tools that make excellent use of mobile-related data—turning metrics into insights and insights into actions.
Create “single pane of glass” views for mobile engineering health (stability, performance, delivery, quality, customer impact), with clear definitions and drill-down paths.
Enable proactive management through leading indicators and alerting (e.g., early detection of regressions, risk signals before release, anomaly detection in crash/performance patterns).
Partner with mobile leadership to define KPIs that matter, establish targets, and drive measurable improvement over time.
AI Evangelism & Engineering Community Enablement
Evangelise practical AI usage across the engineering community: run enablement sessions, publish playbooks, demo reusable patterns, and mentor teams to adopt AI safely and effectively.
Build a culture of experimentation with discipline—encouraging rapid learning while maintaining engineering standards and auditability.
Act as a trusted advisor to squads: helping them select tools, structure workflows, evaluate outputs, and avoid common AI pitfalls (hallucinations, overconfidence, data leakage, bias).
Create internal documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides to accelerate adoption and reduce repeated effort.
AI-Native Operating Model Support (Partnering with Mobile CTO)
Support the Mobile CTO in shaping an AI-native engineering strategy: identifying the right problems to solve, prioritising investments, and tracking value delivered.
Define lightweight governance that enables innovation while ensuring safe use (e.g., model/tool selection guidance, prompt/data handling standards, evaluation practices, human-in-the-loop controls).
Establish measurement frameworks to quantify impact: cycle time reduction, defect reduction, test coverage improvements, incident reduction, customer experience improvements, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure AI adoption aligns with architecture, security, compliance, and broader technology strategy.
Requirements
Essential
Proven ability to use AI effectively to solve real engineering problems (design, coding, testing, analysis, automation), with a pragmatic and outcomes-focused mindset.
Strong problem-solving abilities, including diagnosing ambiguous issues and translating them into data/AI solutions that ship.
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), able to influence and enable engineers and leaders across teams.
Strong experience building production-grade data pipelines and datasets, with attention to reliability, observability, and data quality.
Proven ability to build dashboards/analytics products that drive action, not just reporting.
Strong understanding of secure data handling and engineering practices appropriate for a regulated environment.
Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and risk/security stakeholders.

Job Summary
Provide technical leadership for the SABRE team’s adoption of artificial intelligence, developing secure, reusable AI-enabled tools, services, and data access and integration capabilities that connect with the team’s platforms, data, knowledge sources and engineering workflows.
Drive end-to-end automation across the software delivery lifecycle, from requirements and development through testing, deployment, operational validation and evidence generation.
Drive the transformation of SABRE delivery processes through the application of AI and intelligent automation, moving beyond isolated use cases to end-to-end workflow enablement. Design and implement AI-enabled capabilities that support requirements analysis, solution development, integration delivery, testing, release management, batch execution, operational validation, evidence generation and production support. Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve engineering productivity and accelerate platform upgrades while maintaining appropriate controls, resilience, transparency and auditability.
Key Responsibilities
AI Engineering and MCP Enablement
Design, build and maintain production-grade AI platforms, tools and intelligent automation capabilities that integrate with SABRE systems, data, documentation and delivery processes. Establish reusable mechanisms that enable AI solutions to safely discover, access and execute engineering and operational tasks while maintaining appropriate controls, auditability and governance.
Establish reusable patterns for prompt and context management, tool discovery, authentication, authorisation, observability, evaluation, guardrails and human oversight.
Integrate AI capabilities with existing SABRE architecture, APIs, CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, avoiding isolated proofs of concept and enabling adoption at scale.
End-to-End Automation and Release Acceleration
Identify high-value manual activities and implement end-to-end automation spanning build, test, deployment, release validation, control evidence and operational handover.
Drive the AI-enabled transformation of engineering validation and release processes, developing capabilities that can automatically generate, execute and assess unit, integration, regression, performance and resilience testing, analyse results, investigate anomalies, identify likely root causes and support release-readiness decisions. Ensure all activities produce traceable evidence, auditable outcomes and reliable execution within delivery pipelines.
Develop AI-assisted review of test outputs, logs, dataset comparisons and release results to detect anomalies, summarise findings and route exceptions for human decision.
